editionLabel: dV Giochi Italian rules, English summary
firstPlayerRule: The player with the most exotic animal at home goes first.
houseFallback: If this criterion does not suit your group, agree to choose randomly. This is a house rule.
clarifications: That player receives the lion marker and card holder, and places the first estimate cube. Play continues clockwise.

internalEvidence: Starting instructions were checked on rendered publisher pages, including relevant mode context. Publisher source context: https://www.dvgiochi.com/area-download/. Finding: The player with the most exotic animal at home goes first. Local source SHA-256: 2b916889193a3fa4c8ede9101da354408741db604062e55d6c6194ad73065a9c. Base game with 180 animal cards and a lion starting-player marker; not a junior or compact edition.
uncertainty: The source does not define how to compare how exotic the animals are, or give a special rule for a group without animals at home.
